nit : "Persist" should be in lower case
Do we need to create corresponding PDI changes? https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/tree/master
I have to check and raise separate PR for this. Thanks

>BMC boots and reboots

What is the difference between "boots" and "reboots"?

I feel this part can be re-phrased to be easier to understand. Maybe something like:

"This commit implements populating "Available" property during the inventory priming stage. Handling "Available" property during FRUs VPD collection will be handled in future commit(s)".
Suggestion : Blank line above and below this line
Not needed now. As there is change in the way code is updated now in latest patchset.
We can create an entry in `constants.hpp` for "Enabled".
Return value of this API is not being checked.
nit: we can check for chassis power on and return from here. This will eliminate indentation of the code block below.

This boolean OR check suggests there can be a scenario where `insertOrMerge()` return successful (`true`) but `l_errCode` is set, which is ideally not possible.

We can check `if(insertOrMerge() == constants::FAILURE)` and then log.
IMO we don't have to check any condition other than if error code is set or not.

This check is not required while priming. Priming flow already takes care if the paths are published or not?

I can see that we have that check for rest of the functionality as well. That also does needs to be fixed.
Updated in this PR for "Available" property .
